title: Global MMLU: Understanding and Addressing Cultural and Linguistic Biases in Multilingual Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating MMLU questions to identify those requiring culture-specific knowledge (e.g., Western-centric concepts) and comparing the performance and rankings of 14 multilingual LLMs on culturally-sensitive versus culturally-agnostic subsets.

Identifying questions that require region-specific knowledge, analyzing their distribution across different continents and countries, and evaluating model accuracy on these geographically sensitive questions.

Measuring the impact of translation artifacts (translationese) by comparing language model performance on high-quality human-translated data versus machine-translated data across high-, mid-, and low-resource languages.
Annotating questions for distinctive language variations, regional slang, or idiomatic expressions in English, and grouping them into the culturally-sensitive dataset to evaluate model comprehension.
